items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Bob played trumpet with us. Archie Robinson played trombone.

ctx.x: Is he dead now? No, I don't know him.
From your little Bob Anthony? Yeah, little Bob Anthony. Hospital in Velocity. Yeah, Bob played trumpet with us. Archie Robinson played trombone. Rene Moikadel.
